clips.title: Shifted Passage
clips.prompt: The nearest partition shifts slightly and redirects the open passage. Camera: Restrained handheld phone movement with one small imperfect adjustment. One person operates a handheld phone. Use at most one small physically possible camera movement. No orbit, drone, crane, gimbal, floating camera or movement through objects. Keep the camera nearly held; use one tiny adjustment at most. End state: The former straight passage now ends at a mirrored column. No monster or substitute figure appears. Animate only subjects and objects already visible in the start frame.

clips.title: Moving Reflections
clips.prompt: The reflected light moves once across the fixtures and settles on the floor. Camera: Mostly held handheld phone shot with one slight imperfect reframe. One person operates a handheld phone. Use at most one small physically possible camera movement. No orbit, drone, crane, gimbal, floating camera or movement through objects. Keep the camera nearly held; use one tiny adjustment at most. End state: A narrow band of reflected light settles across the concrete floor. No monster or substitute figure appears. Animate only subjects and objects already visible in the start frame.
